subject: Compliance add-on pricing options & pilot path for Medrix Health
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@medrixhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medrixhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: Compliance add-ons — initial requirements and pricing ask

Hi David,

Thanks for taking time to chat earlier. Attached is a short requirements doc (medrix_comp_request_040527.pdf) that summarizes what our security and legal teams asked for. High level: Medrix is building a secure pilot for a new telehealth feature and we need clear options and ballpark pricing for the following add-ons so we can budget and circulate internally:

- Audit logs: retention for 13 months, immutable export, ability to pull by request ID; expected event volume ~6M events/month (roughly 100k API calls/month).
- KMS: customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) and an option for dedicated HSM for the pilot.
- Data residency: US-only production region, and we may want a separate EU instance by Q4.
- HIPAA attestation and any additional controls for PHI ingest.

We'd like:
- One-page SKU-style options (what's included per tier) and indicative list prices.
- Any one-time fees (HSM provisioning, onboarding), and a view on seat vs per-GB pricing for audit retention.
- Typical lead times for dedicated HSM and residency commitments.

We are aiming to start a 3-month pilot in early May. Do you have something you can share by EOD Monday?

Thanks — copying procurement for PO visibility.

Regards,
Alice Turner
Head of Platform Partnerships
Medrix Health

Attachment: medrix_comp_request_040527.pdf
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@medrixhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medrixhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T11:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — initial requirements and pricing ask

Hi Alice — thank you, and appreciate the clear requirements doc. I attached a concise options deck (redwood_compliance_options_v3.pdf) that maps SKUs to those four areas and includes ballpark pricing and typical lead times. Summary here so procurement can see the choices quickly: 

Option A — Compliance Essentials (lowest friction)
- Audit logs: 90-day retention, standard export; included.
- KMS: multi-tenant CMK (BYOK support but not dedicated HSM).
- Residency: hosted US region.
- HIPAA: covered via SOC2 + Business Associate Addendum (BAA).
Indicative: $1,000–$2,500/month in add-on fees for the volume described. No one-time fees.

Option B — Compliance Plus (recommended for pilot)
- Audit logs: 13-month retention, immutable export, indexed search.
- KMS: BYOK with dedicated key material (logical separation); optional HSM seat for higher FIPS level.
- Residency: US-only tenant with contractual residency SLO.
- HIPAA: BAA + additional logging hooks for compliance teams.
Indicative: $8k–$15k/month + one-time provisioning for HSM ($15k–$30k) depending on dedicated vs shared HSM.

Option C — Enterprise Secure (production-grade)
- Dedicated HSM(s), reserved capacity, extended retention SLAs, cross-region residency options.
Indicative: custom quote; typically starts at $40k/month for the profiles that need a single-tenant HSM and extended retention.

Questions to refine pricing: committed monthly spend for the pilot, whether Medrix wants an actual dedicated HSM seat in month 1, and whether audit logs must be searchable via Redwood Console or exported to your SIEM. If you can confirm those three items I can produce a one-page proposal and a redlineable SOW by Thursday.

Lead times: multi-tenant BYOK changes are immediate; dedicated HSM provisioning is typically 3–6 weeks depending on region and security approvals. Residency contractual language can be included in the MSA with standard timelines (2–3 weeks for agreement).

I attached the options PDF. Happy to hop on a short call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_compliance_options_v3.pdf
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T14:20:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Compliance add-ons — initial requirements and pricing ask — Medrix (strategy)

Team — forwarding Medrix's ask and my reply. Key commercial decision points we should align on before I send the firm one-pager:

1) Pilot concession: customer requests pilot in May (3 months). I propose a pilot discount structure: 15% off list for the pilot term OR waive first-month audit-retention overage charges, whichever they prefer. Thoughts?

2) HSM economics: recommended to offer two options: (a) per-seat dedicated HSM one-time provisioning fee $25k + $6k/month, or (b) shared logical HSM (higher assurance than BYOK) for $12k/month with no provisioning fee. Margin on (a) is tighter but easier to justify with a committed $25k/mo spend.

3) Audit log retention pricing: propose $0.02/GB/month after first 50GB included in Compliance Plus. For 13-month retention, expected storage cost for them is ~2–3k/month; propose we price at $4k/month in package to cover indexing/search.

4) Residency/BAA: no discounting on residency contractual SLOs; these are legal risk items.

If we want to be aggressive, we can split provisioning fee over 12 months to reduce upfront for Medrix. Recommend we hold list price but offer first-year blended discount (e.g., 10–20%) for all add-ons if they commit to a 12-month reserved capacity or $X committed spend.

Please reply with quick thumbs (OK/NOK) and any alternate numbers. I want to finalize the one-pager tonight and then loop procurement.

— David
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Compliance add-ons — initial requirements and pricing ask — Medrix (strategy)

David / Ben — quick takes:

- Pilot concession: OK to offer 15% off pilot for first 3 months, but tie to a short mutual action plan with clear acceptance criteria. If they convert to a 12-month commitment within 30 days after pilot, give an additional 5% credit applied retroactively.
- HSM: prefer split-provisioning (amortize $25k over 12 months) — makes the sticker less scary. Keep $6k/month seat price. For shared logical HSM, cap at 1–2 customers per cluster to protect assurances; price at $12k/month as you suggested.
- Audit logs: agree with $0.02/GB/month as baseline; round package to $4k/month to include indexing and search. If they commit to 12 months we can offer 10% off storage line.
- Residency/BAA: cannot discount.

Ben — please confirm there is enough margin if we amortize provisioning fee over 12 months. If margin goes below 35% we should keep provisioning up-front.

Lauren
VP, Revenue Operations
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T11:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Compliance add-ons — initial requirements and pricing ask — Medrix (strategy)

Lauren — ran quick model. If we amortize the $25k provisioning fee over 12 months at $2,083/mo and charge $6k/mo for seat, blended monthly is ~$8,083. At list $6k seat + amortization our blended gross margin stays around 38% (after infra/support). If they want a lower effective monthly, we can push more into a 12-month committed capacity credit instead of discounting the HSM seat.

Agree on pilot 15% off and MA Plan. Also agree on storage rounding to $4k/month. We should include a clause to convert any pilot-specific provisioning fees into credits against a committed order if they sign a 12-month term.

Ben
Senior Pricing Manager
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@medrixhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medrixhealth.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T15:30:00Z
Subject: Proposal and pilot path — Medrix compliance add-ons

Hi Alice — following internal alignment, here is a concise proposal and next steps. I included the commercial bullets below and attached a draft SOW (SOW-Medrix-draft.docx) for your procurement team to review.

Pilot proposal (3 months) — Compliance Plus (recommended):
- Audit logs: 13-month retention, indexed search; package price $4,000/month.
- KMS: option A (shared logical HSM): $12,000/month, no upfront provisioning; or option B (dedicated HSM): $6,000/month + $25,000 provisioning (we can amortize provisioning over 12 months on the invoice to reduce upfront).
- Residency: US-only tenant, contractual residency SLO included.
- HIPAA: BAA to be appended to MSA.

Pilot commercial concessions:
- 15% off the monthly add-on fees for the 3-month pilot.
- If Medrix signs a 12-month committed order within 30 days of pilot completion, we will apply an additional 5% credit retroactively to the pilot charges and amortized provisioning fees will be credited against the committed spend.

Next steps:
1) Procurement: review attached SOW and confirm PO timing.
2) Security: if you want us to start HSM provisioning in parallel, we need a signed SOW and a runbook exchange to start background checks (this reduces lead time).
3) Legal: we'll include BAA language and residency clauses in the MSA.

If you approve, I can send a DocuSign link for the SOW and an invoice schedule showing an amortized provisioning option.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
